description: This file defines the 'PostingPeriod' class responsible for modeling a period within which interest is calculated and posted for a savings account. It includes methods to create instances based on transactions, handle interest computation, and manage interest periods with various compounding types (daily, monthly, quarterly, etc.). The class encapsulates details such as balance intervals, interest rates, interest transfer status, and period end dates.

classes.name: PostingPeriod
classes.description: Represents a period for interest posting in a savings account, handling calculations, transaction balancing, and compounding specifics for that period.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Creates an instance of PostingPeriod using detailed transaction data, balances, interest settings, and date ranges.

methods.name: createFromDTO
methods.description: Creates an instance of PostingPeriod from a Data Transfer Object (DTO) representation of transactions and interest settings.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Returns the calculated interest for this posting period.

methods.name: dateOfPostingTransaction
methods.description: Returns the date when interest posting transaction is recorded.

methods.name: closingBalance
methods.description: Returns the closing balance of the period.

methods.name: openingBalance
methods.description: Returns the opening balance of the period.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest earned for the period based on compounding periods and interest rates.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Returns the rounded interest earned in this period.

methods.name: getInterestEarned
methods.description: Returns the interest amount earned during this period.

methods.name: isInterestTransfered
methods.description: Indicates whether interest has been transferred for this period.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval representing this posting period.

methods.name: isUserPosting
methods.description: Indicates whether the posting was initiated by a user.

methods.name: getFinancialYearBeginningMonth
methods.description: Returns the month in which the financial year begins.

methods.name: getClosingBalance
methods.description: Returns the closing balance for the period.
